visual_elements.description: Left panel: 2D scatter with red (#CC0000) L-shaped axes (no tick labels). A solid red (#CC0000) query point near center-top. Thin gray (#999999) lines radiate from the query point to 20 neighbor points. Neighbors are filled circles ringed by dashed magenta (#C850C8) circles: a green (#7AB648) cluster of ~8 points at lower-left, a blue/cyan (#5BC8E8) cluster of ~9 points at upper-right, and ~3 ringed orange/tan (#E8C88A) points at bottom-center (derived: 20 ringed total minus ~8 green minus ~9 blue; source counts approximate) plus at least 1 unringed orange/tan point (exact unringed count unspecified in source). One bright green point at far lower-left appears unringed.

Right panel: dot plot of exactly 20 nearest neighbors sorted left-to-right by increasing distance from the query point. Each neighbor is a small colored dot (cyan #5BC8E8 on the left transitioning through green #7AB648 to orange/tan #E8C88A on the right) with a thin dotted vertical line dropping to a red (#CC0000) dot on the x-axis baseline (exactly 20 red baseline dots, one per neighbor). A vertical blue (#0000CC) line near the right side marks the K=20 cutoff boundary. Annotation at top: 'K=20, green class' with 'green' on a bright green (#00CC44) highlight. Red (#CC0000) L-shaped axes, no tick labels.
Yellow (#F5E96B) filled circle badge containing black (#000000) number '50' (slide number)
